source_documents.count_note: Fourteen unique source documents are used: five primary/official records and nine independent reports. AP's post-close report independently corroborates the 25 November US market close and priority-company price observations.

limitations: S&P's ratings-actions page is dynamically rendered; the official indexed action row confirmed AA / CreditWatch Negative, while Reuters provided the rationale.
US intelligence reporting relies on people familiar with classified briefings and does not establish espionage or wrongdoing.
TIME's historical ownership findings do not establish current state ownership, current control or unlawful conduct.
The single-source estimate that up to half of future Southeast Asian capacity may not proceed is unverified and is not treated as a base case.
The ABS information-media-and-telecommunications category is broader than data centres.
SATS is diversified and its cargo growth is not wholly attributable to AI.
MiniMax's current Talkie revenue share is not disclosed; the reported 2024 contribution is historical.
No timestamp-aligned valuation dataset was assembled.
